name: Pixel Critters
description: Arcade critters: little five-by-five pixel sprites, each mirrored down the middle with two eyes, rolled fresh in every cell.

code.style: --rule: ( --a0: @p(#000, #000, transparent); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --b0: @p(#000, #000, transparent); --c0: @p(#000, #000, transparent); --a1: @p(#000, #000, transparent); --a2: @p(#000, #000, transparent); --b2: @p(#000, #000, transparent); --a3: @p(#000, #000, transparent); --b3: @p(#000, #000, transparent); --c3: @p(#000, #000, transparent); --a4: @p(#000, #000, transparent); --b4: @p(#000, #000, transparent); --c4: @p(#000, #000, transparent); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 15%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, @var(--a0) 0 20%, @var(--b0) 20% 40%, @var(--c0) 40% 60%, @var(--b0) 60% 80%, @var(--a0) 80%) 0 0% / 100% 20.8% no-repeat, linear-gradient(90deg, @var(--a1) 0 20%, transparent 20% 40%, #000 40% 60%, transparent 60% 80%, @var(--a1) 80%) 0 24.75% / 100% 20.8% no-repeat, linear-gradient(90deg, @var(--a2) 0 20%, @var(--b2) 20% 40%, #000 40% 60%, @var(--b2) 60% 80%, @var(--a2) 80%) 0 50% / 100% 20.8% no-repeat, linear-gradient(90deg, @var(--a3) 0 20%, @var(--b3) 20% 40%, @var(--c3) 40% 60%, @var(--b3) 60% 80%, @var(--a3) 80%) 0 75.25% / 100% 20.8% no-repeat, linear-gradient(90deg, @var(--a4) 0 20%, @var(--b4) 20% 40%, @var(--c4) 40% 60%, @var(--b4) 60% 80%, @var(--a4) 80%) 0 100% / 100% 20.8% no-repeat; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
